children: Hornbeck Offshore Services Inc. (HOS) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 03, 2026.

On September 2, 2026, Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), posted a presentation to its website to be used, or the basis of which will be used, in communications with investors. The presentation materials are attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and are incorporated herein by reference. The presentation materials are also available on the "Investors" page of the Company's website, https://hornbeckoffshore.com/. Investors and others should note that the Company routinely uses the "Investors" page of its website to announce material information to investors and the marketplace. While not all of the information that the Company posts on its website is of a material nature, some information could be deemed to be material. Accordingly, the Company encourages investors, the media, and others interested in the Company to review the information that it shares on https://hornbeckoffshore.com/. Information contained on, or accessible through, the Company's website is not a part of and is not incorporated by reference in this Current Report on Form 8-K or in any of the Company's other filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The information contained in Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, is being "furnished" and shall not be deemed "filed" for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other filings under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866829/000119312526380897/d138666d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866829/000119312526380897/0001193125-26-380897-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
